description: Consommation et production électrique du quartier Bastide 2023 - 2025 is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Dictionnaire Public Ce jeu de données présente jusqu'au 02/01/2025 (données désormais millésimée), pour le quartier Bordeaux Bastide, un historique de consommation et de production d’électricité (photovoltaïque) par tranche de 30 minutes. Coverage: Bordeaux Bastide. The portal files it under Energie. Its keywords are énergie, data-gouv, poste monitoré, poste HTA-BT. The portal shows 28,355 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-01-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
